name: 23-convert-claude-messages-sys-extract
description: convertClaudeMessages (prompt-converters.js:197-376) with `useSysPrompt` true: the leading run of system turns is lifted into `systemPrompt` and spliced off the array (:200-220), while the later system turn is *not* -- it is rewritten to 'user' in place and loses its `name` (:253-267). The example pairs exercise the name prefixing at :254-263: 'example_user' gains `userName + ': '`, and 'example_assistant' is left alone because it already starts with `charName + ': '`, so the `startsWithGroupName` predicate is short-circuited rather than called. `names` arrives through the `$promptNames` sentinel, so the object is the real one either way. The two user turns that result from the rewritten system turn are merged (:346-353).
